Designing an online learning platform ahead of its time.

I designed GoodSemester starting in 2009 as a truly modern learning management system for colleges and universities. It contained a full suite of tools for online education including an interactive grade book, collaborative note taking tools, discussion boards, group work, assignment submission and more. Designing GoodSemester involved extensive collaboration with teachers, students, and the administrative faculty of schools.

GoodSemester entered public beta in early 2012 after a lengthy private beta with multiple universities. However, after I discovered that users in the general public primarily wanted tutorial creation tools, I shut the service down and pivoted the company into Squareknot.
